desc: Independently validate the implementation against brute-force results on exhaustive and random small cases.
Derive a correct cyclic perimeter representation and an exact formula for Manhattan distance between boundary points.
Characterize fixed-distance feasibility via cyclic perimeter gaps.
Design an efficient \(O(nk\log side)\) feasibility algorithm.
Prove the feasibility criterion, including wraparound, corners, same-side points, and the \(D \leq side\) bound.
Combine feasibility with integer binary search.
